steps.title: Configure MCP Servers
steps.description: Set up FireCrawl and DataForSEO MCP servers for scraping and SEO analysis
commands: claude mcp add firecrawl -e FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=$FIRECRAWL_API_KEY -- npx -y firecrawl-mcp
claude mcp add dataforseo -e DATAFORSEO_LOGIN=$DATAFORSEO_LOGIN -e DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD=$DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD -- npx -y dataforseo-mcp-server
